callees.name: is_cli_backend_enabled
callees.pre_condition: The FM-Agent runtime configuration has been loaded.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when the configured LLM backend is codex-cli or claude-cli; returns False when the configured backend is opencode.

callees.name: build_agent_command
callees.signature: build_agent_command(model, prompt, cwd, files=None, backend=None, effort=None) -> AgentCommand
callees.pre_condition: model is a non-empty string; prompt is a non-empty string; cwd is a directory path string; files is None or a list of file path strings.
callees.post_condition: Returns an AgentCommand whose argv field is a list of command-line argument strings that, when executed as a subprocess with cwd as the working directory, invokes the specified CLI backend with the given model, prompt, and files using that backend's argument conventions. Each file in files appears as a file argument in the command list exactly once.
